newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said spokesman Constantin Verros would brief reporters on Commissioner Hans van den Broek's meeting with the Former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia (FYROM) Foreign Affairs Minister at 1700/1500 GMT in his office.
In answer to a question, spokesman Patrick Child said the Commission spring economic forecast would be released on April 23, 1997.

Asked wether there was a contradiction between the promotion programmes for quality beef and the ban on British beef exports, spokesman Gerry Kiely said it was more a case of promoting British beef in Britain.
Van der Pas said there had been no vote in the Commission on the French textile industry aid plan.
Asked to deny that Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy was not happy with the Commission's decision to ban the plan, Child did not do so.
Kiely said the EU-U.S. negotiations on meat imports inspection standards were still going on. He also said he was not very optimistic on the poultry issue.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/280: Humanitarian aid: news in brief.
- IP/97/284: Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan hails opening of WTO financial services talks.
- IP/97/286: Promotion programmes for quality beef.
- IP/97/287: Presentation of the green paper on trade by Commissioner Christos Papoutsis at the plenary session of the Committee of Commerce and Distribution (CCD).
- IP/97/288: The Commission authorizes the acquisition of control by Rheinbraun Brennstoff GmbH of Agenzia Carboni S.r.l.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Population and social conditions No 1997-4: Education in the EU, opportunities and choices.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Economy and finance No 1997-12: GDP in volume, first results for 1996.
